title: 第22章 让她去吧（求追读）
novel_title: 恶毒女配又装纯，禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
【他该不会有系统吧？】和铃在心里问。

    舔狗系统毫不犹豫反驳：【怎么会。系统又不是大白菜，怎么可能夜弦也有。】

    【真的吗？】

    【可是我都有两个系统啊。】

    【额......】舔狗系统也有些动摇了。

    姜暮烟唰地一下拔出紫烟剑拦在和铃身前，横眉冷眼看向走来之人，“夜师弟，我们不欢迎你，还请离开，日后不要再出现在我小师妹眼前！”

    夜弦目光望向和铃，“和铃，我有话要单独和你说。”

    看也没看姜暮烟一眼，十分的傲慢。

    和铃声音冷漠：“我和你没什么说的。”

    同心线起了作用，她现在一点也没感受到系统给的惩罚的痛感。

    夜弦唇角露出一丝笃定的微笑，“你会想和我聊的。”

    和铃翻了个白眼。

    神经病。

    居然这么自信。

    夜弦带着怀念的神色问道：“你还记得玲珑珠吗？”

    玲珑珠？

    和铃回忆了一下，想起来了。

    原身苦恋夜弦而不得，给他送了不少的天材地宝，但夜弦一直对她冷冰冰的，有一年她生辰，喝多了酒，硬从夜弦那里要了一颗红色珠子，当做他给自己的生辰礼物。

    那是原身唯一从夜弦那里得到的东西，向来珍之爱之。

    原身把玲珑珠穿进了碧玉宫铃的挂绳上。

    夜弦忽然提玲珑珠是什么意思？

    难道她的碧玉宫铃在他手中？

    夜弦追上了楼沉月，拿回了她的储物戒吗？

    和铃起身，看向夜弦，“去哪里说话？”

    “阿铃！”

    “小师妹！”
content_en:
The coercion emanating from a Nascent Soul monster was so frightening that the faces of the Yin Yang Sect turned to stone.

Suddenly, another strange aura of Nascent Soul came.

Lou Chenyue's expression changed.

"It's Zhenjun Mingse of Nanhua Sect!"

"Why is she here too?"

"Retreat first!"

"It is not appropriate to have a conflict with the Nanhua Sect these days."

The elder of the Yin Yang Sect raised his hand and waved, and several disciples around him turned into a wisp of gray smoke and fled away.

Lou Chenyue and He Lingyao looked at each other. As soon as he took a step forward, a cold sword light came through the air.

The monster's shadow shrouded it, dragging Lou Chenyue and disappearing from the place.

True Lord Mingse glanced at the direction in which the other party was escaping and did not pursue him.

She put away her sword and walked towards He Ling.

"A Ling, you didn't..." Master Mingse's words stopped when he touched the blood-seeking hole on the girl's white arm.

She blames herself: "I came too late and made A Ling suffer."

Under the repair of Zhenjun Mingse's spiritual power, the wounds on Heling's arms gradually disappeared.

She smiled and shook her head: "A-Ling didn't suffer."

She had inflicted the wound on herself.

I hope the pain will make Lou Chenyue remember that there is still such a person like her.

If someone forgets her here, she will be blamed for not responding to the sky and the earth.

He Ling was brought back to Hunyuan Peak by Lord Mingse.

It's just a shame that her storage ring and magic weapon are all at Lou Chenyue's place and she hasn't gotten them back.

Fortunately, there is a concentric line between her and Lou Chenyue, and she can find Lou Chenyue's whereabouts.

He Ling planned to solve the problem of spiritual power collapse first before looking for him.

"Master, did you really give away the Taiqing Jade Liquid?" He Ling asked.

True Lord Mingse smiled slightly and said, "Of course it's fake."

"Lou Chenyue's Wuji Huntian Diao has never seen the real Taiqing Jade Liquid. I just used a drop of thousand-year-old chalcedony dew to trick it."

Wuji Huntian Diao......

Does Paint Paint have such a domineering name?

Unexpectedly, it looks small and cute, but is actually a Nascent Soul ferocious beast. It usually disguises itself very well!

"Okay, A-Ling, you are frightened by this. I will send you back to Han Champs to have a good rest."

He Ling still had something to ask and was reluctant to leave, "Master, seven days have passed. Where is the little Qilin?"

"Has it recognized its owner?"

"Which fellow disciple finally made a contract with it?"
